final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode-connected nfet sinks IREF
MB  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2
* tail current source
MT  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=2
* NMOS input pair (vinn -> diode side, vinp -> output side)
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M2  n2 vinp tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=1
M4  n2 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M7  vout n2 vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=1
MO  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=10 L=2
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RZ  n2 nc 30000
CC  nc vout 1.5e-12
.ends dut
